title.zh: Which Economic Tasks are Performed with AI? Evidence from Millions of Claude Conversations

title.zh: #452 – Dario Amodei: Anthropic CEO on Claude, AGI & the Future of AI & Humanity

note.zh: Lex Fridman 访谈，与 Anthropic 同事 Amanda Askell、Chris Olah 一同讨论 Claude、规模化以及通向 AGI 的路径。

title.zh: Machines of Loving Grace: my essay on how AI could transform the world for the better https://t.co/CFGd4Sbq86

note.zh: 发表文章《慈悲机器》(Machines of Loving Grace),阐述AI如何能让世界变得更好。

title.en: Dario Amodei (Anthropic CEO) — The hidden pattern behind every AI breakthrough
title.zh: Dario Amodei (Anthropic CEO) — The hidden pattern behind every AI breakthrough

note.en: Early Dwarkesh interview on why large models scale so well and what aligning them will require.
note.zh: 较早期的 Dwarkesh 访谈，谈大模型为何能随规模持续变强，以及对齐它们需要什么。

title.en: The Capacity for Moral Self-Correction in Large Language Models
title.zh: The Capacity for Moral Self-Correction in Large Language Models

note.en: Tests whether RLHF-trained language models can avoid producing harmful outputs when simply instructed to do so.
note.zh: 检验经过 RLHF 训练的语言模型能否在被明确要求时自行避免产生有害输出。

title.en: Discovering Language Model Behaviors with Model-Written Evaluations
title.zh: Discovering Language Model Behaviors with Model-Written Evaluations

note.en: Anthropic paper showing language models can be used to generate the evaluations that test their own behaviors.
note.zh: Anthropic 论文展示了如何用语言模型自动生成评估其自身行为的测试集。

title.en: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
title.zh: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback

note.en: Introduces Constitutional AI: training a harmless assistant from AI feedback against a written set of principles, the method behind Claude.
note.zh: 提出宪法式 AI：依据一套成文原则用 AI 反馈训练无害助手，也是 Claude 背后的方法。

title.en: Measuring Progress on Scalable Oversight for Large Language Models
title.zh: Measuring Progress on Scalable Oversight for Large Language Models

note.en: Proposes a human-model interaction benchmark for scalable oversight, the problem of supervising systems that outperform their supervisors.
note.zh: 提出以人机交互实验衡量可扩展监督，即如何监督能力超过监督者的系统。

title.en: In-context Learning and Induction Heads
title.zh: In-context Learning and Induction Heads

note.en: Anthropic interpretability work arguing that induction heads account for much of in-context learning in transformers.
note.zh: Anthropic 的可解释性研究，论证归纳头是 Transformer 上下文学习能力的主要来源。

title.en: Toy Models of Superposition
title.zh: Toy Models of Superposition

note.en: Shows how networks store more features than they have neurons, giving a concrete model of polysemanticity that grounds later interpretability work.
note.zh: 说明神经网络如何叠加存储多于神经元数量的特征，为多义性给出具体模型，奠定了后续可解释性研究的基础。

title.en: Red Teaming Language Models to Reduce Harms: Methods, Scaling Behaviors, and Lessons Learned
title.zh: Red Teaming Language Models to Reduce Harms: Methods, Scaling Behaviors, and Lessons Learned

note.en: Reports Anthropic's red-teaming methods, how attack success scales with model size, and releases the resulting dataset of attacks.
note.zh: 报告 Anthropic 的红队方法、攻击成功率如何随模型规模变化，并公开了由此得到的攻击数据集。

title.en: Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know
title.zh: Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know

note.en: Anthropic study of model calibration and self-knowledge, showing large models can partly predict which questions they will answer correctly.
note.zh: Anthropic 关于模型校准与自我认知的研究，表明大模型在一定程度上能预测自己哪些题会答对。

title.en: Predictability and Surprise in Large Generative Models
title.zh: Predictability and Surprise in Large Generative Models

note.en: Anthropic paper on predictability and surprise in large generative models, presented at ACM FAccT 2022.
note.zh: Anthropic 论文研究大型生成模型中的可预测性与突现能力，发表于 2022 年 ACM FAccT 会议。

title.en: Scaling Laws and Interpretability of Learning from Repeated Data
title.zh: Scaling Laws and Interpretability of Learning from Repeated Data

note.en: Measures how duplicated training data degrades large language models and traces the damage back to specific internal mechanisms.
note.zh: 量化重复训练数据对大语言模型性能的损害，并追溯到模型内部的具体机制。

title.en: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
title.zh: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

note.en: Applies preference modelling and RLHF to train a helpful and harmless assistant, the training recipe underlying Claude.
note.zh: 用偏好建模和 RLHF 训练有用且无害的助手，是 Claude 训练方法的基础。

title.en: A General Language Assistant as a Laboratory for Alignment
title.zh: A General Language Assistant as a Laboratory for Alignment

note.en: Anthropic's first alignment paper, establishing the helpful, honest and harmless framing used across its later work.
note.zh: Anthropic 的第一篇对齐论文，确立了后续工作沿用的"有用、诚实、无害"框架。

title.en: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
title.zh: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code

note.en: Introduces Codex and the HumanEval benchmark for evaluating code generation; Amodei is among the authors.
note.zh: 提出 Codex 以及用于评测代码生成的 HumanEval 基准；Amodei 位列作者之一。

title.en: Scaling Laws for Autoregressive Generative Modeling
title.zh: Scaling Laws for Autoregressive Generative Modeling

note.en: Extends the scaling-law result from language to images, video, multimodal models and mathematical problem solving.
note.zh: 把缩放定律从语言扩展到图像、视频、多模态模型与数学问题求解。

title.en: Learning to summarize from human feedback
title.zh: Learning to summarize from human feedback

note.en: Shows that summarizers trained with human feedback beat supervised baselines and even human reference summaries.
note.zh: 证明用人类反馈训练的摘要模型能超过监督基线，甚至超过人工参考摘要。

title.en: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
title.zh: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners

note.en: The GPT-3 paper, introducing few-shot in-context learning at scale — one of the works the registry cites for him.
note.zh: GPT-3 论文，提出大规模少样本上下文学习，是登记表中列出的其代表作之一。

title.en: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
title.zh: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models

note.en: The original scaling-laws paper, relating language model loss to model size, dataset size and compute by a power law.
note.zh: 最初的缩放定律论文，用幂律刻画语言模型损失与模型规模、数据量和算力的关系。

title.en: Fine-Tuning Language Models from Human Preferences
title.zh: Fine-Tuning Language Models from Human Preferences

note.en: The first paper applying reinforcement learning from human preferences to language model fine-tuning.
note.zh: 首次把基于人类偏好的强化学习用于语言模型微调的论文。

title.en: An Empirical Model of Large-Batch Training
title.zh: An Empirical Model of Large-Batch Training

note.en: Introduces the gradient noise scale, a measurable quantity that predicts how large a training batch can usefully get.
note.zh: 提出梯度噪声尺度这一可测量指标，用于预测训练批量能有效增大到多少。

title.en: Reward learning from human preferences and demonstrations in Atari
title.zh: Reward learning from human preferences and demonstrations in Atari

note.en: Combines human demonstrations with preference queries to learn reward functions for Atari agents.
note.zh: 把人类示范与偏好查询结合，为 Atari 智能体学习奖励函数。

title.en: Supervising strong learners by amplifying weak experts
title.zh: Supervising strong learners by amplifying weak experts

note.en: Proposes iterated amplification: training strong learners on objectives assembled by amplifying weaker human experts.
note.zh: 提出迭代放大方法：通过放大能力较弱的人类专家来构造目标，从而训练更强的学习者。

title.en: Variational Option Discovery Algorithms
title.zh: Variational Option Discovery Algorithms

note.en: Connects variational option discovery to variational autoencoding and introduces a curriculum for learning many skills.
note.zh: 把变分选项发现与变分自编码联系起来，并提出一种用于学习多种技能的课程式训练方法。

title.en: AI safety via debate
title.zh: AI safety via debate

note.en: Early alignment proposal in which two AI systems debate before a human judge as a scalable oversight mechanism.
note.zh: 早期对齐方案：让两个 AI 系统在人类裁判面前辩论，作为可扩展监督的一种机制。

title.en: The Malicious Use of Artificial Intelligence: Forecasting, Prevention, and Mitigation
title.zh: The Malicious Use of Artificial Intelligence: Forecasting, Prevention, and Mitigation

note.en: Multi-institution report surveying security threats from malicious uses of AI and proposing forecasting and mitigation measures.
note.zh: 多机构联合报告，梳理 AI 被恶意使用带来的安全威胁，并提出预测与缓解措施。

title.en: Claude Opus 5 released
title.zh: Claude Opus 5 发布

body.en: Positioned as near-frontier capability at roughly half the price of Claude Fable 5. Follows Fable 5 (9 Jun) and Sonnet 5 (30 Jun).
body.zh: 定位为接近前沿能力、价格约为 Claude Fable 5 一半。此前有 Fable 5（6/9）与 Sonnet 5（6/30）。

title.en: Confidential S-1 filed; October Nasdaq listing targeted

body.zh: 此前完成 650 亿美元 H 轮，投后估值 9650 亿美元，年化收入 470 亿美元。

title.zh: Andrej Karpathy 加入 Anthropic 预训练团队

body.zh: 向预训练负责人 Nick Joseph 汇报；Eureka Labs 独立运营 22 个月后结束。

title.zh: AMD 将向 Anthropic 投资最多 50 亿美元

body.en: Part of a compute-capacity agreement.
body.zh: 作为算力合作协议的一部分。
